tips.text: Land Sear on a target that is already burning to stun them. Hit them with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first.
Aim Pillar of Flame where the enemy is about to be, not where they stand. It lands after a short delay, so use it on targets that are stunned or cornered.
Sear stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion or monster in the way will block it. Line up a clear shot before you cast.
Use Conflagration on a burning target to spread the blast much further. It reaches enemies standing near them and clears camps faster.
Three stacks of Blaze on a champion make them explode shortly after. Stack it fast, then force them to stay near their team.
Cast Pyroclasm on a small group of enemies so it keeps bouncing between them. A lone target gets hit again only if the bounces have nobody else to go to.
Hit an enemy already burning with Pyroclasm and they are slowed, so use it to finish a chase.
Killing a burning enemy gives you mana back. Use your abilities on camps to keep your mana up.

combos.name: W into Q stun
combos.when: Use it when you want a reliable stun on an enemy who is dodging your Sear.
combos.text: Pillar of Flame has a delay and sets the target ablaze, so Sear then stuns. Land the pillar first, since it is easier to hit, then follow with Sear.

combos.name: E into Q stun
combos.when: Use it when the target is in range and you want a quick, certain stun.
combos.text: Conflagration is a targeted spell that always applies Ablaze. Sear then stuns the target with no aiming needed for the first spell.

tips.text: Hit an enemy with Conflagration or Pillar of Flame first, then follow with Sear to stun them. Sear only stuns a target that is already ablaze.
Aim Sear carefully, because it stops at the first enemy it hits. Minions in the path will block it before it reaches the champion.
Cast Conflagration on a minion standing next to the enemy to spread fire onto them. It spreads farther when the target is already ablaze.
Throw Pillar of Flame where the enemy is about to step, not where they stand. It lands after a short delay, so a moving target will walk out of it.
Pillar of Flame is best used on a stunned or ablaze enemy. It hits harder against targets that are already ablaze.
Land three stacks of Blaze on an enemy champion and stay near them. After a short delay they explode and hurt everyone close by.
Use Pyroclasm on a small group so it can hit the same target several times. Against a lone enemy it can bounce back to you.
Save Pyroclasm for a target that is already ablaze. It slows them, so they cannot easily escape the rest of your combo.
Poke with Conflagration when the enemy stands near their minions. Setting them ablaze there can push them away from the wave.

combos.name: W into Q stun
combos.when: Against a target that is slow, stuck or predictable, when you want the most damage.
combos.text: Pillar of Flame lands after a delay, so aim it where the enemy is going. Once it hits, Conflagration and Sear follow quickly, and Sear stuns the ablaze target.

tips.text: Land Sear on a target that is already burning, because that stuns them. Start with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration to set them ablaze first.
Aim Pillar of Flame where the enemy will walk, not where they stand. It lands after a short delay, so use it on enemies who are stunned or stuck.
Sear stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the line eats it. Line up a clear shot before you throw it.
Cast Conflagration on a minion standing next to the enemy so the blast spreads onto them. It reaches even farther if the target is already burning.
Use Conflagration to push enemies off their minions. Burning them with it makes them stay away from the wave.
Cast Pyroclasm on a small group of enemies so it bounces onto the same target more than once. It also slows burning targets.
Three stacks of Blaze make the target explode after a short delay. Keep them in range, or stun them, so the explosion hits.
Hit an enemy with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first, then land Sear on them. Sear stuns only a target that is already ablaze.
Cast Conflagration on an ablaze enemy standing near their minions. The blast spreads twice as far and also burns the minions around them.
Aim Sear carefully. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way will absorb it.
Pillar of Flame lands after a short delay. Aim it where the enemy is moving, or on someone who is stunned or rooted.
Use Pyroclasm on a small group of enemies so it bounces onto the same target several times. Wait for level 6 to start using it.
Three stacks of Blaze make an enemy champion explode after a short delay. Keep your spells on them so the blast hits their nearby allies too.
Open on Graves with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration to set him ablaze, then Sear him for the stun.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Graves will stand, not where he is. It has a short delay, so he can step out of it.
Graves's Smoke Screen blocks your vision outside the cloud. Step out of it before you commit your combo.
Keep your distance from Graves. His shotgun hurts up close and Quickdraw closes the gap quickly.
Save Pyroclasm for when Graves is ablaze and near others or low on health. It slows him and follows him even if he walks out of sight.

comboRefs.note: Conflagration always applies Ablaze, so Sear stuns Graves even when he would dodge a skillshot.

tips.text: Hit Jarvan with Sear first, then follow with another spell. An ablaze Jarvan gets stunned.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard, or you get knocked up.
Pillar of Flame has a delay, so cast it where Jarvan will be after he lands, not where he stands.
Use Pyroclasm on Jarvan when he is trapped in his own Cataclysm ring with you; he cannot easily walk out.
Land Sear on Kayn only after another spell has set him ablaze; then he is stunned and cannot dash away with Reaping Slash.
Save Pyroclasm for when Kayn is ablaze and close. It slows him, and he cannot pull away easily.
Kayn's Umbral Trespass needs him to damage you first. Stay out of his reach and punish him with Pillar of Flame when he walks in.
Hit Kayn with Conflagration while he is inside terrain after Shadow Step; damaging him there shortens it.
Stay near your minions, allies or a turret when Kha'Zix is around. He deals far less damage with Taste Their Fear when you are not isolated.
Hit Kha'Zix with Sear after another spell has set him ablaze. He gets stunned, and you can finish with Pillar of Flame.
Use Conflagration on a target that is already ablaze to spread the blast much further. It is a safe way to set up several enemies at once.
Aim Sear carefully. It stops at the first unit it hits, so a minion in the way soaks it.
Save Pyroclasm for when Kha'Zix has used Leap, because he is easy to catch afterward. Once he is ablaze it slows him.

comboRefs.note: Conflagration always applies Ablaze, so Sear stuns him without aiming the first spell.

tips.text: Hit Kindred with Sear after another spell has set her ablaze; she is stunned and can't dash away with Dance of Arrows.
Kindred is fragile, so open on her with Pillar of Flame while she stands still, then finish her with Conflagration.
Do not ultimate into Lamb's Respite; nobody inside can die, so wait until it ends.
Stay out of her fights when you are low; Mounting Dread slows you and her third attack makes Wolf pounce.
Aim Sear at Lee Sin only when he is already ablaze, so it stuns him. Open with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration to set him ablaze first.
Lee Sin is weak to magic damage, so build your fights around your spells rather than backing off from him.
Keep your distance and hit Lee Sin from long range. Sear and Pillar of Flame reach far, while his gap closer needs a marked target.
Stay away from your teammates when you fight Lee Sin. His Dragon's Rage kicks one champion into others and hurts them all.
Hold Pyroclasm for when Lee Sin is ablaze, so he is slowed and cannot easily run or chase.

comboRefs.note: Pillar of Flame sets him ablaze first, so Sear still stuns even if Lee Sin tries to dodge it.

tips.text: Hold Sear for when Master Yi is ablaze, since the stun is your best way to stop him from reaching you.
Don't rely on Pyroclasm's slow once Master Yi turns on Highlander; he is immune to slows then. Use your stun instead.
Master Yi vanishes during Alpha Strike, so wait until it ends to throw Pillar of Flame where he lands.
Poke him early with Sear and Conflagration, so he has to spend mana on Meditate to heal.

comboRefs.note: Conflagration is targeted and sets Yi ablaze, so Sear stuns without aiming even if Yi is dodging.

tips.text: Land Sear on Naafiri after another spell has set her ablaze, so she is stunned and cannot dive on you.
Aim Pillar of Flame where she will land, since it has a short delay. Cast it on an ablaze Naafiri for much more damage.
Use Conflagration on her packmates or her; it spreads to everything nearby and sets them all ablaze, so you hit her through her pack.
Hold your damage while she is untargetable after The Call of the Pack; spells cast during it are wasted.
Keep Pyroclasm for when she commits to a fight. Its slow on ablaze targets makes it harder for her to escape.

comboRefs.note: Conflagration is targeted, so the Ablaze-then-Sear stun still lands when Naafiri dashes around.

tips.text: Land Sear on Nocturne after he's ablaze to stun him. Without that stun, he can dash in on you.
Don't throw your first spell while Shroud of Darkness is up. It blocks one ability, so bait it out with a cheap Pillar of Flame.
Keep Pyroclasm ready when Paranoia darkens the map. It can slow him as he lands on you, and his dash can be blocked by a spell shield.
Stay away from Nocturne's reach. Unspeakable Horror is broken when you get out of range, so walk away from him once it lands.
Stand near your team when Paranoia is cast. Nocturne's jump is hard to survive alone, so keep allies close.
Open with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration to set Shyvana ablaze, then land Sear for the stun. Sear alone will not stun her.
Keep your distance and poke with Sear and Pillar of Flame. Shyvana wants to get close and fight.
Aim Pillar of Flame where she is heading, not where she stands. It lands after a short delay, and her Inferno Aegis makes her faster.
Save Pyroclasm until she is ablaze. It slows her and can finish her when she is low on health.
Hold Conflagration for when she steps near her allies or jungle minions. It spreads farther on an ablaze target.

comboRefs.note: Targeted Conflagration guarantees Ablaze, so Sear stuns Shyvana without her dodging a skillshot.

tips.text: Start your combo with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration, then follow with Sear so the stun lands on an already ablaze Skarner.
Stay at long range and keep Skarner from closing in. His Shattered Earth slows, and he wins a long fight once he sticks to you.
Aim Sear carefully. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way soaks it.
Watch for Ixtal's Impact. Save your stun from Sear for when he charges at you, because a stun ends his charge.
Fight away from walls when Skarner charges. If he drags you into one, you take damage and are stunned.
Hit Sylas with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first, then follow with Sear so he is stunned when the fireball lands.
Stay back and aim Sear carefully. If Sylas dodges it, your combo has no way to start.
Finish Sylas with Pyroclasm when he is low. Kingslayer heals him, so do not let him get close and heal back up.
Stand where Sylas cannot reach you with Abduct. Once he has dashed in and pulled onto you, you are knocked up and in trouble.
Keep Pyroclasm in mind when Sylas has stolen it. His copy comes from his own stats and he can fire it back at you.

comboRefs.note: Targeted Conflagration guarantees Ablaze, so Sear stuns even if Sylas dashes with Abscond.

tips.text: Hit Talon with Sear only after another spell has set him ablaze; the stun gives you time to finish the combo before he jumps on you.
Aim Sear carefully at Talon. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way takes the fireball instead.
Use Pyroclasm on Talon when he is ablaze; it slows him and bounces to him first, which makes his escape harder.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Talon will stand, not where he is. It has a short delay, so wait until he commits to a jump.
Keep Conflagration ready for when Talon turns invisible and runs. It targets a unit, so you need to see him to cast it; use it before he vanishes.

comboRefs.note: Conflagration is targeted, so Sear stuns Talon with no aim needed even if he vaults or turns invisible.

tips.text: Land Sear on Viego first to set him ablaze, then follow with Pillar of Flame for the bonus damage and a stun you can plan around.
Sear stops at the first unit it hits, so line it up with no minions or monsters in front of Viego.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Viego will be, not where he stands. It has a delay, and his dashes can slip out.
Hold Pyroclasm for when Viego is low. It bounces to him and slows him if he is ablaze, which helps you finish him before he can get his kill-heal.
Kill Viego fast when a fight ends, because a dead champion becomes a wraith he can use. Do not leave a low ally near him.
Hit Xin Zhao with Sear first to set him ablaze, then stun him with a second spell before he reaches you.
Keep your distance; Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge closes ground fast, so stay behind your minions or allies.
Sidestep the Wind Becomes Lightning thrust; it is a thin line, and getting hit slows you and lets him charge farther.
Use Pillar of Flame on Xin Zhao when he is ablaze; it hits harder. Aim where he is walking, since it lands after a short delay.
Once Xin Zhao uses Three Talon Strike on you, move away; his third hit knocks you up.

comboRefs.note: Conflagration always sets Xin ablaze, so Sear stuns him with no need to aim the first spell.
Pillar of Flame sets Xin ablaze, so Sear then stuns him even if he dodges Sear.

tips.text: Land Conflagration or Pillar of Flame first to set Ahri ablaze, then follow with Sear for the stun.
Stand behind minions when Ahri has Charm ready; it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Ahri will dodge to or recall to; its delay makes it easy to sidestep if she sees it coming.
Poke her with Conflagration while she farms; it hits nearby minions too and keeps her ablaze.
Hold Pyroclasm until Ahri is ablaze and low; it slows her and bounces onto her more than once if she stands near few others.
Be careful after Ahri uses Spirit Rush to dash in; she can slip away or get close to you fast, so keep your spells ready.
Land Sear on Akali before she gets close; if she is ablaze from another spell, she is stunned and cannot jump on you.
Aim Pillar of Flame at the smoke where Akali vanishes. Area spells still hit her inside Twilight Shroud and briefly show her.
Hold Pyroclasm for when Akali is low and wants to dive. It slows her while she is ablaze and can bounce onto her several times.
Poke with Conflagration from range early. It spreads to nearby minions, so you can set Akali ablaze while she stands by them.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Anivia will step, since it lands after a short delay. Walls and slows make her predictable.
Land a spell first, then Sear. The stun needs ablaze, and a stunned Anivia can't escape your combo.
Dodge Flash Frost; if it hits, Frostbite's damage is doubled. Step out of its path early, since the ice keeps flying past targets.
Her egg comes back at full health, so don't spend Pyroclasm on her unless you can finish the kill.
Pick off the egg when it appears; she can't act while it is out.
Land Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first, then follow with Sear so it stuns the ablaze Aurora.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Aurora will land after her hop, since it erupts after a short delay.
Use Conflagration on a target, not on empty ground, so it can still hit Aurora while she is invisible or out of sight.
Save Sear for when she walks up or lands near you; she can be hit on the first try only if nothing stands in front of her.
Hold Pyroclasm for when she is low and already ablaze; it slows her and finishes her before she can escape.
Hit Cassiopeia with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first, then follow with Sear; an ablaze target gets stunned by it.
Aim Sear carefully; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way takes it instead of Cassiopeia.
Stay out of her Noxious Blast range and don't stand still; she wants to poison you and follow with Twin Fang.
Use Conflagration on a minion near her; the blast spreads to her and lights her ablaze from a safe distance.
Pillar of Flame has a delay, so cast it where she is walking. She is slowed in her own Miasma, which makes it easier to hit.
Land Sear on Fizz only after something has set him ablaze; Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first, then Sear stuns him.
Don't cast Pillar of Flame at Fizz while he can dodge it; its delay lets him dodge it with Playful. Cast it when he is slowed or committed.
Save Sear for when Fizz dashes at you. Fizz is a hard target to hit with it while his dash and Playful are ready.
Keep Conflagration ready to poke Fizz from range, since it can't be dodged by walking away once cast.
Stay away from walls and your own minions' blind spots when Fizz has Chum the Waters; step sideways to dodge the fish.
Land Conflagration or Pillar of Flame first, then Sear; the fireball stuns once he is ablaze.
Stay out of Call of the Void range and sidestep it; being silenced leaves you unable to cast your combo.
Don't waste a combo while Malzahar's Void Shift is up; wait until he has been hit or stunned out of it.
Use Pillar of Flame on his path when he walks up to farm; it has a delay, so aim where he is going.
Avoid standing near minions carrying Malefic Visions; when they die, it spreads to you.
Land Sear on Orianna after Conflagration or Pillar of Flame sets her ablaze, so she is stunned and you can follow up.
Use Conflagration on a minion next to Orianna to set her ablaze from range. Its spread is wide.
Watch where her Ball sits; Command: Shockwave only hits near it. Stay out of that area when she has level 6.
Aim Pillar of Flame where she will walk, not where she stands. It lands after a short delay.
Don't chase her through the slowing field of Command: Dissonance; you will be slowed.

comboRefs.note: Pillar of Flame is delayed, so Orianna's Shockwave knockback can disrupt aim; best against a slowed or stuck target.

tips.text: Poke with Pillar of Flame when Ryze walks up to last-hit; it hurts more if he is already ablaze.
Land Conflagration on Ryze or a nearby minion to set him ablaze, then follow with Sear to stun him.
Stay out of Rune Prison range; if Ryze has Flux on you, it roots you instead of slowing.
Stun Ryze while he channels Realm Warp to cancel the portal.
Land Sear on Sylas only after another spell has set him ablaze, so he is stunned and can't dash away.
Stay back from Sylas when you have no spell ready. Abduct pulls him onto you, so keep your distance until Sear and Pillar of Flame are up.
Cast Conflagration on a minion next to Sylas. It spreads to him and sets him ablaze, then follow up with Pillar of Flame.
Hit Sylas with a combo before he can use Kingslayer to heal back. Do your trading while his health is high.
Don't cast Pyroclasm at Sylas hoping to bounce, since he can steal it with Hijack. Wait until his Hijack is on cooldown.
Aim Sear down the lane at Twisted Fate; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions in the way will block it.
Start with Conflagration or Pillar of Flame to set him ablaze, then follow with Sear to stun him.
Back off when Twisted Fate is shuffling Pick a Card; the Gold Card stuns you, and the Red Card slows you.
Use Conflagration on a minion next to Twisted Fate; if it is ablaze, the blast spreads twice as far and hits him.
When Destiny goes off, expect Twisted Fate or an ally to teleport in; leave the lane or stay close to your team.
Land Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first, then Sear; Sear stuns only a target that is already ablaze.
Sear stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it where minions will not block the path to Viktor.
Stay out of Gravity Field. Standing in it too long gets you stunned, which leaves you open to his follow-up.
Use Conflagration on a target near Viktor's minions. It spreads to them and works as poke.
Walk sideways out of the line of Hextech Ray, since it is a narrow beam.
Cast Pyroclasm when Viktor is already ablaze, so he is slowed and cannot easily walk out of the follow-up.
Aim Sear at Yasuo only when a minion is not in the way; the fireball ends at the first unit it hits, so line it up with a clear path.
Do not cast Pillar of Flame at Yasuo's feet when he is looking at you. It lands after a short delay, so aim where he will dash.
Set Yasuo ablaze with Conflagration first, then follow with Sear to stun him. A stun gives you time to land Pillar of Flame.
Expect Yasuo to put up Wind Wall when you cast Pyroclasm or Sear. Wait for it to fade, or cast around it, before you fire.
Conflagration is not a projectile Wind Wall can stop, according to the wiki. Use it to set Yasuo ablaze even when his wall is up.
Keep your distance and poke with spells. Yasuo wants to dash onto minions to reach you, so stay back when he has minions near.
Yasuo's whirlwind from Steel Tempest knocks you up, so back away when he has hit two stabs in a row.
Land Sear on Yone when he walks up to the wave; the fireball stops at the first unit, so aim where no minion stands in front.
Set Yone ablaze with Conflagration or Pillar of Flame first, then Sear him so he is stunned and can't close the gap.
Pillar of Flame has a delay, so cast it where Yone is heading, not where he stands. It is easy to dodge when he is dashing.
Keep your distance and poke with Conflagration; it has long range and hits the enemy and nearby minions, so Yone has to fight through the burn to last-hit.
Save Sear for when Yone has two stacks of Mortal Steel and is about to dash in. Stunning him then wastes his engage.
Use Pyroclasm on a Yone who is already ablaze; it slows him and the bounces can hit him several times when he is alone.
Do not stand right next to your wave when Yone has Fate Sealed ready. It can pull you in and stun you.
Aim Sear at Zed through minions only when none stand in the way; the fireball ends at the first unit it hits, and Zed can hide behind them.
Set Zed ablaze with Conflagration or Pillar of Flame first, then Sear him to stun him. A stunned Zed can't dash in on you.
Zed has to get close to hurt you, so keep Pillar of Flame ready for where he lands. It has a short delay, so aim at where he is walking, not where he stands.
Stay at long range and poke with Conflagration and Sear while Zed's Energy is low. Zed has little to answer with when he can't reach you.
Don't waste Pyroclasm on Zed alone just to bounce it. Use it on Zed when he has been set ablaze, so he is slowed and can't easily get away.
Hit Ashe with Sear, then follow with Pillar of Flame. She has few ways to escape.
Land Conflagration on a minion standing next to Ashe. It spreads to her and sets her ablaze, so you can set up Sear.
Be careful in the brush and when you walk up to her. Volley hits hard and slows you, and Ashe's slows make it hard to get away.
Don't wander alone when Enchanted Crystal Arrow is ready. Stay near your team so you can't be stunned far from help.
Land Sear on Caitlyn, ideally through a minion fight where she has to dodge it. A hit starts your combo.
Do not walk into Caitlyn's long range to poke her. Stay behind your minions, because Piltover Peacemaker hits less hard on later targets.
Watch for Yordle Snap Trap on the ground before you step forward. If you are rooted, Caitlyn gets a bonus Headshot on you.
Open with Pillar of Flame, or Conflagration on a minion, to set Caitlyn ablaze. Follow with Sear to stun her.
Hit Caitlyn with Pyroclasm when she is near her minions or support. It bounces between enemies and slows ablaze targets.
Start trades with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration to set Ezreal ablaze, then land Sear for the stun.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Ezreal will walk, not where he stands; it lands after a short delay, and he can easily step out.
Stay out of line with Ezreal's Mystic Shot. Standing behind minions keeps Sear's fireball from being your only threat while you stay safe.
Sear stops at the first enemy it hits, so line it up where no minion stands between you and Ezreal.
Cast Conflagration on a minion next to Ezreal; it spreads to him, and spreads further if the minion is ablaze.
Ezreal can blink away with Arcane Shift, so save a spell to hit him as he lands, or use Pyroclasm to finish him.
Use Pyroclasm when only Ezreal and his support are close together, so it bounces onto him more.
Land Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first to set Jhin ablaze, then follow with Sear so it stuns him.
Wait until Jhin has fired his last shot and is reloading, then jump on him with your combo; he cannot attack during the reload.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Jhin will walk, since it lands after a short delay. It is best against him while he is reloading or stopped to hit minions.
Cast Conflagration on a minion standing next to Jhin; the blast spreads to him and sets him ablaze, which discourages him from last-hitting.
Watch for Jhin's invisible traps and stay out of Deadly Flourish range when your support has hit you; it roots you and leaves you open.
Land Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first, then Sear; Sear only stuns Jinx if she is already ablaze.
Cast Conflagration on a minion next to Jinx; it spreads to her and sets her ablaze, and the spread is wider if the minion is already ablaze.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Jinx will step, not where she is; it lands after a short delay and she can walk out.
Stay out of Zap! range and keep minions in front of you; the shot stops on the first enemy it hits.
Stand away from your own team when you use Pyroclasm so it can't bounce back and forth between you and a single target.
Land Sear on Kai'Sa only after something has set her ablaze; then she is stunned and you can follow up freely.
Hit Kai'Sa with Pillar of Flame when she is rooted in place or busy trading; it is slow to land, so do not throw it at a walking target.
Cast Conflagration on a minion next to Kai'Sa to hit her too; it spreads further if the target is ablaze.
Stay out of her reach after she shows Void Seeker; she outranges you and can poke you from far away.
Save Pyroclasm for when Kai'Sa is ablaze and close to your support; it bounces between them and slows her.
Expect Killer Instinct to jump her onto your support or you. Keep Sear ready to stun her when she lands.
Hit the enemy with Sear first. If you can follow with Pillar of Flame, they take more damage while ablaze.
Cast Conflagration on a minion next to Miss Fortune. It spreads further when the target is ablaze, so she gets hit too.
Sear can be blocked, so line it up with no minion in front. She will dodge it if you cast it where she can see it coming.
Cast Pillar of Flame where she will walk, not on her feet. Her Strut makes her fast when she is not taking damage.
Stay out of Make It Rain's area. It slows you and hurts, which makes it hard to dodge the rest of her combo.
Hold Pyroclasm for when she and her support stand close together. It bounces between them and hits hard.
Land Sear or Pillar of Flame first to set Smolder ablaze, then follow with Sear to stun him.
Smolder is weak early, so trade aggressively and punish him before he stacks Dragon Practice.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Smolder will step, since it has a delay. Use it when he is slowed or stopped.
Cast Conflagration on a minion next to Smolder and his support; the blast spreads to them and sets them ablaze.
Save Pyroclasm for when Smolder and his support stand close together, so it bounces between them.
Start trades with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration, then follow with Sear so the Ablaze target is stunned and cannot walk out of the rest of your combo.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Yunara will be standing, since it lands after a short delay. Throw it when she is busy attacking minions or has used her escape.
Yunara can slow you with her prayer bead from long range. Stay out of its line, or sidestep it, when you walk up to trade.
Hit Yunara with Conflagration while she stands near her minions. The blast spreads further on an Ablaze target, so it can burn the wave around her.
Yunara's Transcend One's Self gives her dashes and a stronger beam. Hold Sear for when she dashes in, and play safer while she is transcended.
Land Sear on Bard only after something has set him ablaze; then he is stunned and cannot answer.
Use Conflagration on a minion next to Bard; the blast spreads and sets him ablaze, and it spreads further if the minion is already burning.
Cast Pillar of Flame where Bard will walk, such as when he goes for a chime. It lands after a short delay, so aim ahead of him.
Stay out of a straight line with your own minions and your ally. Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a second target or a wall.
Hold Pyroclasm when Bard uses Tempered Fate on himself and his ally; it puts everything hit in stasis, so wait until it ends before you fire.
Aim Sear at Karma only once she is already burning; otherwise it just deals damage and no stun.
Step out of Focused Resolve's range quickly so the tether breaks and you avoid the root.
Use Pillar of Flame where Karma will stand while she is casting; she must stay still for it.
Dodge Inner Flame by standing behind a minion in its path. It stops at the first unit it hits.
Karma's shield from Inspire blunts your burst. Wait until it runs out before you commit Pyroclasm.
Keep your distance from Leona and poke with Sear; the fireball stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it where no minion stands in the way.
Stay out of Zenith Blade range. Its long reach plus a dash and a root means a careless step forward gets you caught.
Land Pillar of Flame on her when she walks up, since it has a delay. Follow with Sear to stun her once she is ablaze.
Use Conflagration on a minion next to Leona and her ally. It spreads to hit both and sets them ablaze.
Save Sear for when Leona dashes in. Stunning her before her attack lands can stop her engage.
Stand apart from your carry when Leona is near, so Pyroclasm and her Solar Flare do not catch you both together.
Aim Sear carefully at range; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way eats it. Throw it when the lane is clear.
Open with Conflagration on a target near their minions or Lulu to set several enemies ablaze, then follow with Sear to stun an ablaze target.
Lulu can polymorph you with Whimsy during your combo. Stay out of her range and keep Pillar of Flame for when she steps up.
Glitterlance slows you hard, so keep your distance and don't walk into a straight line from Lulu and Pix.
Use Pyroclasm on Lulu and her carry when they stand close together, so it bounces between them.
Land Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first to set Lux ablaze, then follow with Sear for a stun. Sear alone will not stun.
Stay out of a straight line with your minions and your ally. Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits, so do not line up behind a minion.
Use Conflagration on a minion next to Lux. It spreads to her and sets her ablaze without a skillshot.
Once Pillar of Flame and Sear have hit the fragile Lux, Pyroclasm adds a lot of burst. Save it for when she is ablaze.
Walk out of Lucent Singularity's zone instead of staying in it. Its slow makes Pillar of Flame easier for Lux to dodge and leaves you open to her Light Binding.
Hit Milio with Pillar of Flame when he stands still to cast; the delay is short, but he often pauses to cast.
Set an enemy ablaze first, then land Sear to get the stun. Sear stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it past minions.
Use Conflagration on Milio or his carry when they stand close together; the blast spreads to everyone near the target.
Hold Pyroclasm until Milio's Breath of Life is used or his team is bunched up; it bounces between nearby enemies.
Step out of line from Ultra Mega Fire Kick; it is a straight shot and the first enemy it hits is knocked back.
Land Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first, then follow with Sear; an Ablaze Nami gets stunned by it.
Pillar of Flame is slow to land, so cast it where Nami is walking to, not where she stands, especially when she is stuck on an ally.
Stay out of Aqua Prison range and walk around the bubble's landing spot; it takes a moment to land, so sidestep it.
Once Nami has missed Aqua Prison, step up and trade, because her next bubble is a long way off.
Hit Nami and her partner together with Conflagration; it spreads further on an Ablaze target and punishes them for standing close.
Back off when an enemy is empowered by Tidecaller's Blessing; it wears off quickly.
Land Sear on a target already ablaze to stun them. Start with Pillar of Flame or Conflagration so the stun is guaranteed.
Stay outside Dredge Line range and keep poking with Conflagration and Pillar of Flame. Nautilus needs to land one hook to start his fight.
Stand behind a minion. Dredge Line stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in front of you will take the hook.
Do not let Nautilus walk up and hit you. His first attack roots you, which sets up his combo.
Aim Pillar of Flame where Nautilus will be after a hook or a dash, since it lands after a short delay. It hits hard on a target who is already ablaze.
Save Pyroclasm for when Nautilus is ablaze and low. It slows him, and he is a big target to chase.
Open with Conflagration or Pillar of Flame to set Pantheon ablaze, then follow with Sear so it stuns him.
Stay at long range and poke with Sear and Pillar of Flame. Pantheon has to close the gap to hurt you.
Pillar of Flame has a delay, so cast it where Pantheon will be, such as where he lands after his leap.
Hold Sear while Aegis Assault faces you; he takes no damage from that direction. Wait it out or hit him from the side.
Keep Sear ready for when Pantheon leaps with Shield Vault. A stun in return can stop his follow-up attacks.
Land Sear on Pyke only after another spell has set him ablaze; then he is stunned and cannot hook anyone.
Stay behind your minions, because Sear stops at the first unit it hits and Pyke's hook is just as easy to block.
Poke Pyke with Conflagration from long range; it cannot be dodged by walking around, and it spreads to nearby enemies.
Drop Pillar of Flame where Pyke will be, not where he is; it lands after a short delay, so cast it on his approach path.
When sharks circle under your feet, Pyke is hidden nearby. Step back toward your allies and ready Sear for his arrival.
Finish a low-health Pyke with Pyroclasm before he can hide and heal. Damaging him is pointless if he escapes unseen.
Land Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first to set Senna ablaze, then follow with Sear so it stuns her.
Sear stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it when a minion is not standing in front of Senna.
Senna outranges you with her attacks, so hit her with Conflagration when she steps up to attack minions.
Pillar of Flame has a delay, so cast it where Senna is rooted or about to walk, not where she stands.
Stay away from your ally when Senna lines up Last Embrace; its root spreads to enemies near the target.
Land Sear first or Pillar of Flame first to set them ablaze, then follow with Sear; an ablaze target gets stunned.
Aim Pillar of Flame at where Seraphine will stand, since it lands after a short delay. Her slow ability makes her easy to catch.
Use Conflagration on a minion next to the enemies; it spreads farther if the target is ablaze, so it can set both lane opponents burning.
Stay out of Beat Drop's line. It is a straight shot, so step sideways, because being slowed then rooted lets her team punish you.
Save Pyroclasm for when both enemies stand close together so it bounces onto them and burns them down.
Use Conflagration on a minion next to Sona and her ADC. The spread hits both of them, and it reaches further if the target is ablaze.
Sona has no escape besides Song of Celerity. Land Sear or Pillar of Flame, then follow up to burst her.
Stay out of Sona's range when she has three Power Chord stacks. Her empowered attack hits hard and can slow or weaken you.
Don't use Pyroclasm until you can catch Sona. Her Crescendo stun on you in the middle of a fight can decide it.
Land Pillar of Flame or Conflagration first to set the enemy ablaze, then follow with Sear so it stuns.
Watch for Thresh starting Death Sentence; it has a long cast time, so step out of its line as it begins.
Stay behind your minions when Thresh looks ready to throw Death Sentence, because the scythe stops at the first unit it hits.
Keep your distance from Thresh. Flay only has short range, and it pulls or pushes you and leaves you slowed.
Poke with Conflagration when Thresh stands near his minions or his partner; the blast spreads wider on an ablaze target.
Use Pyroclasm when Thresh and his partner stand close together, so it bounces between them.
